fact_text: Government budget documents include dividend estimates from state-owned companies, but the analyst notes that actual dividends have often come in below these budgeted figures.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 4 June 2025 | OGDC & PPL Pre-Budget 2025-26 Outlook | PSX E&P Sector Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The analyst says the IMF is not satisfied with FBR tax collections, which are short of target, so the government may look to non-tax revenue such as dividends from state-owned energy firms in the FY26 budget.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 4 June 2025 | OGDC & PPL Pre-Budget 2025-26 Outlook | PSX E&P Sector Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: OGDC held about Rs 173 billion in short-term financial assets and Rs 29-30 billion in cash and bank balances over the nine months to March 2025, a total of roughly Rs 200 billion that the government is watching.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 4 June 2025 | OGDC & PPL Pre-Budget 2025-26 Outlook | PSX E&P Sector Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The analyst says OGDC and PPL could pay dividends from their liquid balances before the 30 June 2025 fiscal year-end, which could support the government's non-tax revenue target in the budget.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 4 June 2025 | OGDC & PPL Pre-Budget 2025-26 Outlook | PSX E&P Sector Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: PPL held about Rs 125 billion in short-term investments, largely in mutual funds, plus about Rs 7 billion of cash, roughly Rs 132 billion of liquid assets in the nine months to March 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 4 June 2025 | OGDC & PPL Pre-Budget 2025-26 Outlook | PSX E&P Sector Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: The analyst sees PPL's large liquid balances as a possible source of dividends to the government before or after the budget, a view he frames as a professional opinion rather than a forecast.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 4 June 2025 | OGDC & PPL Pre-Budget 2025-26 Outlook | PSX E&P Sector Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)

fact_text: Long-term investments in Balochistan, including a government stake and an expected Barrick Gold investment, had not yet materialised for the upstream companies, which the analyst says limits the near-term catalysts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 4 June 2025 | OGDC & PPL Pre-Budget 2025-26 Outlook | PSX E&P Sector Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-06-04)
